sentences.text: Sub Marine Store Oy is a cohort company registered on 2021-03-15 under the industry code 46900, non-specialised wholesale trade.
Business Finland shows a funding decision for 2026 of EUR 99 450, but the export gives the year only, not a day.
A programme-entry record is dated 2026-02-09, and first sales are recorded on 2021-03-15.
On the radar's rules the technology and business levels are both 4 and the investment level is 3, all resting on that public funding.
The registered industry is wholesale trade, so ocean impact cannot be read from the record and stays unknown.
For the fund this is a watchlist case until the impact side can be shown from a public source.
